entry.title: MVW2012 Theorem 2 (p.3)
entry.subtitle: wiesner_ideal · A. Molina, T. Vidick, J. Watrous. Optimal counterfeiting attacks and generalizations for Wiesner's quantum money. TQC 2012, LNCS 7582, 45-64. arXiv:1202.4010v1

fields.label: Source and theorem
fields.text: MVW2012 Theorem 2 (p.3): for the classical-verification analogue of Wiesner's scheme, the optimal simple counterfeiting attack succeeds in two independent verifications with probability exactly (3/4 + sqrt(2)/8)^n.

fields.label: Assumptions
items: Note as in P-W1; verification = bank sends a uniformly random challenge c in {0,1}^n, holder returns measurement outcomes, bank checks positions where c matches the preparation basis.
Adversary holds ONE valid note and tries to pass TWO independent classical verifications.
Exact acceptance rule (no error tolerance, no loss), no other oracle access.

fields.label: Parameters
fields.text: n: number of qubits per note, integer >= 1

fields.label: Quantifier over adversaries
fields.text: sup over all quantum strategies holding one note and answering two independent challenges

fields.label: Caveats
items: A different game from W1; its base 0.9268 is LARGER than 3/4 - substituting (3/4)^n here would be optimistic.

fields.label: Bounds
fields.text:
